tool.name: OMIX Volcano Plot
tool.description: Generate publication-ready volcano plots from DEG results
tool.command: mkdir -p results && Rscript '$__tool_directory__/main.R' --deg_table '$deg_table' --pvalue_type '$pvalue_type' #if str($column_with_feature_id) --column_with_feature_id '$column_with_feature_id' #end if #if str($significance_column) --significance_column '$significance_column' #end if #if str($log2_fold_change_column) --log2_fold_change_column '$log2_fold_change_column' #end if --p_value_threshold $p_value_threshold --log2_fold_change_threshold $log2_fold_change_threshold --choose_feature_to_label_by '$choose_feature_to_label_by' --number_of_features_to_label $number_of_features_to_label --label_only_my_feature_list '$label_only_my_feature_list' #if str($my_feature_list) --my_feature_list '$my_feature_list' #end if --top_genes_labeled_only_if_passing_thresholds '$top_genes_labeled_only_if_passing_thresholds' --label_size $label_size --label_box_padding $label_box_padding --label_force $label_force --label_max_overlaps $label_max_overlaps --use_custom_axis_label '$use_custom_axis_label' #if str($custom_significance_label) --custom_significance_label '$custom_significance_label' #end if #if str($custom_log_fold_change_label) --custom_log_fold_change_label '$custom_log_fold_change_label' #end if --plot_title '$plot_title' #if str($plot_subtitle) --plot_subtitle '$plot_subtitle' #end if --y_limit $y_limit --use_auto_axis_capping '$use_auto_axis_capping' --auto_axis_capping_quantile $auto_axis_capping_quantile --auto_axis_capping_symmetric_x '$auto_axis_capping_symmetric_x' #if str($custom_x_axis_limits) --custom_x_axis_limits '$custom_x_axis_limits' #end if --x_limit_padding $x_limit_padding --y_limit_padding $y_limit_padding --plot_title_size $plot_title_size --axis_title_size $axis_title_size --axis_text_size $axis_text_size --point_size $point_size --image_width $image_width --image_height $image_height --resolution_dpi_ $resolution_dpi --color_not_significant '$color_not_significant' --color_fold_change_only '$color_fold_change_only' --color_significant_only '$color_significant_only' --color_significant_and_fold_change '$color_significant_and_fold_change'

param.name: deg_table
param.label: DEG results table
param.help: CSV file with gene-level differential expression statistics (log2FC, p-value columns)

param.name: column_with_feature_id
param.label: Feature ID column
param.help: Column name containing gene/feature identifiers. Auto-detected if blank.

param.name: significance_column
param.label: Significance column
param.help: Column name for p-values. Auto-detected if blank.

param.name: log2_fold_change_column
param.label: Log2 fold-change column
param.help: Column name for log2FC values. Auto-detected if blank.

param.name: my_feature_list
param.label: Custom gene list (comma-separated)
param.help: Only used when 'Label only custom gene list' is Yes

tool.help:
**OMIX Volcano Plot**
Generate publication-ready volcano plots from differential expression analysis results.
-----
**Inputs**
A CSV file containing at minimum:
- A gene/feature identifier column - A log2 fold-change column - A p-value (or adjusted p-value) column
Column names are auto-detected from common conventions (e.g. ``log2FoldChange``, ``padj``, ``Gene``), or you can specify them manually.
-----
**Outputs**
A PNG image of the volcano plot with:
- X-axis: log2 fold-change - Y-axis: -log10(p-value) - Color-coded significance categories - Labeled top genes (configurable)
-----
**Thresholds**
Points are colored by four categories:
1. Not significant (below both thresholds) 2. Fold-change only (passes FC but not p-value) 3. Significant only (passes p-value but not FC) 4. Significant + fold-change (passes both)
